# Security policy

## This add-on

Report security vulnerabilities in this repository (the add-on packaging, its scripts, the Docker
image, or the CI/release pipeline) through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
[Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/Marc-Andrew1503/t3-code-for-homeassistant/security/advisories/new).
Please do not open a public issue and do not disclose the problem publicly until we have had a
reasonable opportunity to investigate and fix it.

Please redact pairing codes, tokens and API keys from anything you send.

## T3 Code itself

This project only packages T3 Code. Report security vulnerabilities affecting T3 Code or
T3 Tools-operated infrastructure to [security@ping.gg](mailto:security@ping.gg), as described in the
[T3 Code security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy).

Vulnerabilities in Claude Code go to Anthropic, not to this repository.
